description: A MIDI input for 14 bit continuous controllers, pairing each of CC 0 to 31 with the CC 32 numbers higher to give finer resolution than 128 steps

outputs.text: The value of its own pair of CC numbers, 0-10V, or -5V to +5V when the menu is set away from unipolar

notes: nothing appears at the outputs until a MIDI device is chosen on the display, which carries its own menus for the driver, the device and the channel
menu: Midi 1.0 — an incoming MSB sets the coarse half of the value and clears the fine half, and the LSB that follows fills it in, as the MIDI 1.0 specification defines
No Zeroing, No Waiting — each message changes its own half of the value the moment it arrives, with nothing cleared and nothing held back
MSB waits for LSB — an incoming MSB is held back until an LSB arrives and the two are applied together; an LSB with no MSB before it changes the fine half on its own
MSB LSB pair — the value changes only once both messages of the pair have arrived
Filter Smoothing — a slider setting the time constant of the filter on every output, up to 67ms, and 33ms by default
Unipolar — switches every output between 0-10V and -5V to +5V
